==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am a member of a superhero team. Everyone on the team lives together in a fancy mansion. We are being filmed for a documentary about heroes.

There are other heroes being filmed for the documentary who are our rivals. We compete with them for the spotlight, as we want to prove that we're better than them. But everything changes once I notice a pink box in the rain.

I open the pink box and discover that it is full of water. The water glows with a magical shine and I am sucked into it. For a brief moment, I gain control over the dream just before I wake up.
